The '''Lorell Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] mostly within the [[Lorelli Reach]] and the [[Rifle Worlds]] of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. It started at the [[Lorell system/Legends|Lorell system]] then connected with the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]], after which there was a junction that connected with the [[Chosper system/Legends|Chosper]] and [[Sennex system/Legends|Sennex]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. From the Sennex system, the hyperspace lane continued through the [[Daruvvia system/Legends|Daruvvia system]], the [[Ket system/Legends|Ket system]], the [[Lovola system/Legends|Lovola system]], and the [[Maires system/Legends|Maires system]] to the [[Vergill system/Legends|Vergill system]], where it ended.<ref name="TEA" />
